greek.policy: Exact verse/index alignment; punctuation ignored; 25 reviewed surface differences. A missing/placeholder gloss whose class=det, lemma=ὁ, and morph=T-* is a reviewed grammatical marker '(article: the)', never claimed as a contextual translation. STEP fallback requires unique same-accented-form and lemma in the same verse. Other missing meanings stay unavailable; no dictionary or generated contextual-gloss fallback. Source original text and accents remain unchanged.
